title: D10 SCRIPT output (build_groups.py)
description: Section 12/D10: 'Item: one subtopic · Worker: SCRIPT (build_groups.py): union-find over D9 links; one candidate group per connected component; each question in at most one group per subtopic. No judgement.' Spec names no output path for D10, so this build writes steps/D10/out/<SUBTOPIC_ID>.json (the ordinary steps/<STEP>/out/<ITEM>.json shape of spec 5.8, with no run label — the same choice D3 made for its own script-written output). D10 is a pure SCRIPT step: no {"error": ...} branch is needed, since a genuinely broken input is a non-zero exit code per scripts/CONVENTIONS.md rule 2, not an output shape. `singletons` and `links_used` are not required by spec — they are recorded so the union-find is auditable (a reader can see which questions were considered and why a component formed) and so a question D9 linked to nothing is visibly accounted for rather than silently absent.

group_id.description: A real repeat-group id minted by lib/ids.py::next_repeat_group_id (spec 6.1, RG-{4 digits}, counter-backed and never reused). build_groups.py reuses the id already on disk for an unchanged member set so a rerun mints nothing new (spec 5.9 idempotence).

members.description: Every question in this connected component, sorted. A component of one is NOT a group (spec 12/D11 Checks: 'groups >= 2 members'); it goes to `singletons`.

singletons.description: Questions in this subtopic that D9 linked to nothing (or whose only links were to questions outside this subtopic). Not a group, not an error — recorded so the subtopic's question set is fully accounted for.

links_used.description: The D9 links that actually fed the union-find for this subtopic, each as a sorted [qid, qid] pair, deduplicated. A spec 12/D9 one-sided link is kept (both directions are the same undirected edge here).
